name: phone_number_parsing_and_formatting
title: Phone Number Parsing, Validation, and Formatting
summary: A capability to parse, validate, and format phone numbers globally. It can identify number types (mobile, landline, etc.) and determine the region of origin.

tools.name: parse_and_analyze_phone_number
tools.description: Parses a raw phone number string and provides a comprehensive analysis including validation, type, and region.

params.name: phone_number_string
params.description: The raw phone number string to parse (e.g., '+1 415 555 2671' or '020 7946 0000').

params.name: default_region
params.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to use if the number is not in international format (e.g., 'US', 'GB'). Defaults to None.

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: Whether the number matches a valid pattern for its region.

returns.name: is_possible
returns.description: Whether the number is a possible phone number (less strict than is_valid).

returns.name: number_type
returns.description: The type of the phone number (e.g., 'MOBILE', 'FIXED_LINE', 'PREMIUM_RATE', 'UNKNOWN').

returns.name: region_code
returns.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code the number belongs to.

returns.name: e164_format
returns.description: The phone number in E.164 format (e.g., '+14155552671').

returns.name: international_format
returns.description: The phone number in international format (e.g., '+1 415 555 2671').

returns.name: boolean_display
returns.description: A human-readable summary of the number's status (e.g., 'Valid: True, Type: MOBILE, Region: US').

returns.name: error
returns.description: If parsing failed, this field contains the error message. Otherwise, null.

returns.name: error_type
returns.description: If parsing failed, this field contains the error-type code. Otherwise, null.

tools.implementation_notes: 1. Call 'phonenumbers.parse(number, region)' to get a PhoneNumber object. Handle 'phonenumbers.phonenumberutil.NumberParseException' to catch errors. 2. If parsing succeeds, use the PhoneNumber object with: 'phonenumbers.is_valid_number(numobj)', 'phonenumbers.is_possible_number(numobj)', 'phonbers.number_type(numobj)', 'phonenumbers.region_code_for_number(numobj)', 'phonenumbers.format_number(numobj, PhoneNumberFormat.E164)', and 'phonenumbers.format_number(numobj, PhoneNumberFormat.INTERNATIONAL)' to gather all data. 3. Convert the PhoneNumberType enum to a string. 4. Return the structured JSON object.

tools.name: format_phone_number
tools.description: Formats an existing valid phone number into a specific format.

params.name: e164_number
params.description: The phone number in E.164 format (e.g., '+14155552671').

params.name: format_type
params.description: description: The format to use: 'E164', 'INTERNATIONAL', or 'NATIONAL'.

returns.name: error
returns.description: If formatting failed, this field contains the error message. Otherwise, null.

tools.implementation_notes: 1. Call 'phonenumbers.parse(e164_number, None)' to get a PhoneNumber object. 2. Call 'phonenumbers.format_number(numobj, format_enum)' where format_enum is mapped from the input string to 'PhoneNumberFormat.E164', 'PhoneNumberFormat.INTERNATIONAL', or 'PhoneNumberFormat.NATIONAL'.

tools.name: get_carrier_info
tools.description: Identifies the carrier/service provider for a phone number.

params.name: e164_number
params.description: The phone number in E.164 format (e.g., '+14155552671').

returns.name: carrier_name
returns.description: The name of the carrier/service provider (e.g., 'Verizon', 'AT&T').

returns.name: error
returns.description: If carrier identification failed, this field contains the error message. Otherwise, null.

tools.implementation_notes: 1. Call 'phonenumbers.parse(e164_number, None)' to get a PhoneNumber object. 2. Call 'phonenumbers.carrier(numobj)' to get the carrier name. Note: carrier identification might return an empty string or 'UNKNOWN' if the carrier is not identifiable.

uncertainties: The 'is_valid_number' check is a pattern match and does not guarantee the number is currently in service or active.
The 'number_type' check might return 'UNKNOWN' if the number is invalid or if the metadata for that region is not available in the library.
Carrier identification is based on the library's internal database and may not be current or complete for all regions.
